seed: A layer row picked up and let go somewhere it cannot land used to stay in the layers list's hand. Nothing looked wrong until the next drag: a colour carried over a row was read as that row coming back, and the list drew a reorder line for a colour. This walk abandons a row drag three ways - over another row, over the picture, and off in the panel with nothing under it - and after each one asks the list what it is holding and carries a colour over a row to see whether a line appears. A walk cannot press escape during a real drag, because it cannot start a real drag session at all; what it can do is leave the drag exactly as escape, a release over the picture and a release outside the window all leave it, which is with nothing ever told that it ended.

steps.note: CONTROL. Nothing has been picked up. A colour carried over a layer row is refused and no line is drawn.
Pick the "Rectangle" row up, carry it over the "Background" row, and walk away without a word.
Pick the same row up and let go of it out over the picture, where a layer row cannot land.
And picked up and dropped in the panel below the list, which is what a release outside the window looks like from in here: nothing under it ever hears that the drag ended.
And the drag this is all for still does its job: a row carried onto another row and let go moves, and the list is empty handed afterwards.
